assessment.nobel_worthiness: Cărtărescu has a highly distinctive voice. His densely patterned, visionary prose turns memory, the body and dream into an architecture that is both metaphysical and formally ambitious. The Blinding trilogy and Solenoid sustain the project at large scale, and the Romanian poetry gives the prose a lyrical base. On the common criteria he scores well on voice, linguistic ambition, imaginative depth and sustained scale.
assessment.attribution: The credit is to one author for a recognisable, cumulative body of work in Romanian. The proposed citation would centre on the visionary-metaphysical novel and its poetic origins, not on national representation.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre spans several decades and is large and coherent. The major novels are already established and the project looks mature, not provisional.
uncertainties: The prose depends on syntactic density and intricate patterning, so translation may flatten some of the achievement.
My knowledge of the poetry and early work comes mostly from secondary reception, and I have not independently verified the texts.
Some of the longer books may be uneven in pacing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Carson remakes the boundaries between classical scholarship, lyric, narrative and visual form. Autobiography of Red reimagines a Greek myth as a verse novel, and Nox is an object-book elegy. Her voice is unmistakable and her formal invention is real. The intellectual depth comes from her classical learning and her translations of Greek texts.
assessment.attribution: The credit is clear to a single author writing in English, with translation and scholarship in the orbit of the creative work. The citation scope would be formal reinvention across genres, with poetry as the core.
assessment.maturity: She has published steadily since the 1990s and has a substantial, consistent body of work. Some of the hybrid forms are still being absorbed by criticism.
uncertainties: Whether genre-crossing works, some of them physical objects, are best judged as an oeuvre in the sense of Nobel's will.
Some of the later work may be more conceptual than expansive.
I rely on public reputation and have not verified the texts.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Michon's compressed, rhythmically exact French prose turns obscure lives and art history into powerful narrative inquiry. Small Lives and The Eleven are the key works. The achievement is concentrated in language and form. It carries real intellectual depth about how lives are recovered, how art relates to history, and how a writer shapes a vocation.
assessment.attribution: The credit is to a single author writing in French. The citation would centre on the fiction of fragmentary lives, written with high stylistic demand.
assessment.maturity: The corpus is small but consistently high in quality over several decades. Its small size is a weakness for the breadth criterion but a strength for sustained quality.
uncertainties: The compression and syntactic density make translation difficult, so judgments of the style in other languages are uncertain.
Whether the narrower, shorter corpus offers enough range and significance across the body of work.
I have not independently verified the texts.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Yan uses grotesque, mythic and allegorical forms to expose ideological and developmental violence in modern China. The Four Books and The Explosion Chronicles show formal daring and moral seriousness. His voice is distinctive, and he writes a form of satire that is also a literary argument about narrative and truth.
assessment.attribution: The credit is to a single author writing in Chinese. The citation would centre on mythic-grotesque fiction as a response to political and social violence. Political context should not by itself count as literary merit.
assessment.maturity: He has a substantial oeuvre across decades. The strongest books appear mature, though quality may vary between works.
uncertainties: Much of the assessment depends on translations, which may mediate the effect of the Chinese prose.
Quality is probably uneven across the large body of work.
Censorship and political symbolism could distort how the work is read, and neither establishes literary merit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Murnane writes radically inward fiction in which landscape, memory and mental images form idiosyncratic systems. The Plains and Border Districts are the key works. His voice is rigorous and singular. The intellectual achievement is a long, self-aware investigation of how fiction records inner life.
assessment.attribution: The credit is to a single author writing in English. The citation would centre on the invention of an introspective prose method.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is consistent over decades and unusually self-contained. Late-career work extends the earlier project.
uncertainties: The narrow range of subject and the repetitive method may limit the claim to significance across a body of work.
The corpus is small and the audience limited.
I have not independently verified the texts.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Magris combines travel, essay and fiction to map Europe through its borderlands, memory and intellectual history. Danube and Microcosms are the representative works. He is a learned and humane writer, and the hybrid form is a real literary achievement. His subject is Central Europe, a field to which my own profile gives me a connection, so I discount my own familiarity with it. That connection is not evidence of preference.
assessment.attribution: The credit is to a single author writing in Italian. The citation would centre on the essayistic-narrative mapping of Central European culture.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is long and consistent. Danube is a landmark, and later work extends the same concerns.
uncertainties: Whether the weight of the oeuvre is literary or scholarly, since it lies on the border between essay and fiction.
Some of the erudition may not translate fully.
I have not independently verified the texts.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Adonis remade Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and a long dialogue with inherited forms. His influence on modern Arabic poetry and his critical writing are central to his significance. The formal and linguistic achievement is high, and the poetry is intellectually ambitious.
assessment.attribution: The credit is to a single poet writing in Arabic. The citation would centre on the renewal of Arabic poetry and on his poetic and critical engagement with tradition.
assessment.maturity: He has a very long career and a large body of work. His influence is well established, which is evidence of durability though not of merit by itself.
uncertainties: Poetry translates unevenly, and my assessment depends heavily on translation.
Public prominence and political commentary should not substitute for a judgment of the poems.
I cannot independently verify the full corpus.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Can Xue writes dreamlike narrative worlds that destabilise ordinary psychology, space and causality. Her voice and her break with realist convention are strong. The imaginative depth is real, and she has a clear place within experimental Chinese fiction.
assessment.attribution: The credit is to a single author writing in Chinese. The citation would centre on experimental, non-realist fiction.
assessment.maturity: She has a long record of publication and a coherent method. It is less clear that the later work extends the early achievement in variety or depth.
uncertainties: Translation of her style is a major uncertainty.
The method is consistent and may be repetitive across a large output.
I rely on public reputation and have not independently verified the texts.
